narratives.Description: Activate Prefer-A Bound #7346 so Antigravity host identity and policy wiring can ship after #7345. This slice covers classify host identity, hook-host registration, and policy defaults for agy.

1. Implement #7346 after github.issue.6609698619 and extend hook-hosts, agent-hooks, host-session-owner, and host-hooks within file_scope.
2. Add a changelog fragment, keep Tracking/Refs only, and run the scoped vitest verify commands.
